test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Maya buys a mobile phone for her child. The phone is marked at ₹21,000 and is offered with two successive discounts of 5% and Z%, respectively. After receiving both discounts, she pays ₹11,172. Find the value of Z.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Price after 1st discount of 5% = 21000 × 0.95 = ₹19950

Total discount amount required from this price = 19950 − 11172 = ₹8778

Second discount percentage Z = (8778 ÷ 19950) × 100

Z = 44%

**∴ The correct answer is 44.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Marked Price (MP) = ₹21,000, Final Selling Price (SP) = ₹11,172, Discount 1 = 5%, Discount 2 = Z%.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/179b6a314055d72c922bc6d800e50ad11eee23429f7603cb0a57ac29d61944c9.png] 

**Formula:** Final SP = MP × (100 − d₁)/100 × (100 − d₂)/100

⇒ 11172 = 21000 × (100 − 5)/100 × (100 − Z)/100

⇒ 11172 = 21000 × (95/100) × (100 − Z)/100

⇒ 11172 = 210 × 95 × (100 − Z)/100

⇒ 11172 = 19950 × (100 − Z)/100

⇒ 11172 ÷ 199.5 = 100 − Z

⇒ 56 = 100 − Z

⇒ Z = 100 − 56

⇒ Z = 44

**∴ The correct answer is 44.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount Formula

When two discounts a% and b% are given successively, the equivalent single discount is given by [a + b − (ab/100)]%.

Effective Price Calculation

The selling price after multiple discounts can be found using the multiplying factor method: SP = MP × (1 − d₁) × (1 − d₂) × ... × (1 − dₙ).

Discount Percentage

Discount % is always calculated on the Marked Price (MP) unless specified otherwise. Formula: Discount % = (MP − SP)/MP × 100.
